config.version_note: v1 (top-150 TF, >=1 shared token, no name filter) failed the collapse gate (interlocutor vocatives + discourse words). v2 (top-190 TF, name filter, >=2 shared tokens) passed gold/stability/precision but operator review found: (a) ranking was term frequency, not the approved document frequency; (b) term-only greek_terms fallback edges (469/1336) created thread members outside the precision/collapse evaluation; (c) adjudications were not persisted or enforced; (d) the phase-2 queue did not encode the authorized-29 boundary. v3: document-frequency stopwording; the first v3 freeze attempt (DF-ranked top-190) was inspected pre-evaluation and found to slice the df=25 band mid-count, readmitting the v1 collapse drivers (μεντοι/εοικεν/παλιν at ranks 196-198), so the rule was refined to a pure df>=25 threshold (231 tokens) BEFORE any evaluation ran; greek_terms demoted to corroboration on primary edges only (no edge creation); persisted adjudication enforced by --check at >=80%; authorized/extension queue split; nonzero exits on stale stopwords, gold failure, or precision failure.
config.normalization: NFD, strip combining marks, lowercase, final sigma to sigma (matches token-index `normalized` column)
config.stopword_rule: union of (a) all normalized tokens with DOCUMENT FREQUENCY >= 25 of 27 dialogues in the full committed token index (a pure df threshold at the natural band boundary: the df=25 band ends the corpus-wide discourse vocabulary, incl. every observed collapse driver, while the nearest inquiry vocabulary sits at df=24 — δοξαν/αγαθον/καλον — and below) and (b) name-like tokens: count >= 5 with >= 90% capitalized surface forms (proper names, vocatives, sigla fragments; Perseus Greek capitalizes names, not sentence starts)
config.link_rule: same-dialogue star per definition-kind seed claim (any review_status); edge iff >=2 shared non-stopword span tokens; greek_terms NEVER create edges — an edge is marked greek_terms_corroborated when a shared span token also appears in either side's greek_terms tokens
config.phase2_execution_rule: Phase 2 consumers MUST load authorized_queue only and MUST reject any relation id in extension_candidates until the operator extends scope; the 2026-07-11 authorization is the 29-relation queue, not the formal flag-rule superset
config.neg_cue_regex: \b(is not|are not|cannot|not the same|not identical|other than|refut|abandon|reject|fails?|absurd|impossible|neither|no longer)\b
config.flag_rule: seed with final_status left_standing|posed_only having >=1 same-thread member at a strictly later start_char whose content matches neg_cue_regex (any review_status)

precision_sample.rule: deterministic PRNG over non-gold primary edges sorted by (seed_id, member_id); half drawn from the dialogue's largest star, half from the remainder
precision_sample.pass_threshold: operator-adjudicated: >=80% of sampled edges inquiry-relevant (shared tokens belong to the seed's definiendum/definiens/test-case vocabulary, not generic names or discourse verbs)

config.phase2_queue_rule: relations with review_status=accepted and resolution=standing whose claim_a or claim_b is a flagged pilot definition; relation ledgers parsed structurally via Bun.YAML

ranking: document frequency (dialogues present) desc, total count desc, token asc
